verdict.rationale: MailerSend's own docs say transactional email can be sent through its SMTP relay instead of the Email API, including from existing software or services. That covers the legacy-app fallback at the core of this story. The evidence never shows generated SMTP credentials or connection details. Missing for 10: documented SMTP credential generation, documented host/port/auth configuration details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send through a documented SMTP relay with generated credentials when my framework or legacy app can't call the REST API

citations.quote: At the moment, transactional emails can be sent through MailerSend’s Email API or using SMTP relay.
Use MailerSend's SMTP to send emails via existing software or services.
Our SMTP relay service takes care of your email delivery so you don’t have to manage an email server.
